prompt_string_leakage.description: Zero identical prompt strings between train_104k and eval_5292.

fact_and_entity_level_leakage.description: The TempUN dataset is constructed from global statistical time-series (V-Dem, Clio-Infra, etc.). Countries and indicators (e.g. Norway Civil Liberties Index) appear repeatedly across multiple adjacent years in both train and eval splits.
fact_and_entity_level_leakage.implication: eval_5292 functions scientifically as an in-distribution development/tuning benchmark rather than an independent out-of-distribution test split.
